question: What do Vietnamese processors pay for lean pork trimmings (for example 80/20 and 90/10), and how does that price track the live hog price?
why_it_matters: Sets the exact saving from extension; our model brackets it at 1.5 to 2.2 times live (conclusions hold across the range, amounts do not)
cheapest_way_to_close: Two purchasing interviews at processors; slaughterhouse price lists in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan; Masan MEATLife; a Binh Duong or Dong Nai slaughterhouse

question: At what rate do Vietnamese processors already include soy protein in value and nutrition lines (binder level or 10 to 20% extension)?
why_it_matters: If extension is already common, R3 is partly baseline and a novel extender has less room; extends OQ-203
cheapest_way_to_close: Two to three R&D interviews; a lab protein-source analysis of five commercial sausages and gio
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan; CJ Cau Tre; Masan MEATLife; HCMUT food technology group

question: In a blind test at equal processor saving, does a fungal extender (about 25% of lean) score at or above the processor own soy-extended formula (20%) in gio lua or xuc xich and in a coarse filling?
why_it_matters: Decides whether fungal biomass can be priced above soy parity in the extension job (T9 kill test, TPP-03); refines OQ-197
cheapest_way_to_close: One central-location test with 100 consumers per format using one processor recipe
owner_org_to_ask: HCMUT or HUST sensory group with Vissan or a co-packer

question: Do Vietnamese rules set a minimum meat or protein content, or require a percentage declaration, for gio, cha or xuc xich (TCVN 8157:2017, TCVN 8158:2017, TCVN 7049:2002, labelling decrees)?
why_it_matters: A minimum meat content would cap R3 directly and shape the honest-labelling move
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the standards text on thuvienphapluat.vn or tieuchuan.vsqi.gov.vn; coordinate with W8-L1
owner_org_to_ask: Directorate for Standards, Metrology and Quality; Vietnam Food Administration

question: Would value-line buyers or consumers prefer a non-soy extender label (dam nam, mushroom protein) to soy protein in a sausage or dumpling?
why_it_matters: The only route for a fungal extender to earn more than soy parity besides higher replacement
cheapest_way_to_close: A 400-person online label choice test with real product photos
owner_org_to_ask: AltProtein Vietnam with a university consumer lab

question: What was the 2025 annual average live hog price, and is there an official monthly series?
why_it_matters: Completes the 2019 to 2026 series (OQ-164); does not change conclusions
cheapest_way_to_close: FAOSTAT 2025 producer price release; NSO CPI pork sub-index request
